newsitem.title: USA: Amoco sees 179 pct production replacement for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Amoco sees 179 pct production replacement for 1996.

text.p: Amoco Corp said it expects to have a 1996 energy equivalent production replacement rate of 179 percent, excluding the effects of property ownership changes, after final calculations are made next month.
After taking into account property ownership changes, the energy giant said it expects the rate to be 164 percent.
The company expects these increases will bring year-end 1996 reserves to about 5.77 billion barrels of oil equivalent, compared to about 5.46 billion barrels at year-end 1995.
"Amoco Corp added more energy reserves than it produced in 1996, primarily due to significant reserves additions in key global growth areas," Amoco said.

"This marks the fourth straight year Amoco has more than replaced the reserves it produced. Reserve additions in Trinidad, Azerbaijan, Egypt, Canada and elsewhere ... more than offset some downward natural gas reserve revisions within the United States. In fact, production replacement outside North America, both inclusive and exclusive of property changes, is estimated at 435 percent," it said.
Amoco projects it will replace 169 percent of the liquids and 181 percent of the natural gas produced last year, exclusive of property ownership changes.
"The company estimates 1996 production of 483 million oil-equivalent barrels, an increase of one percent over the previous year's production," Amoco said.
